data.long_meaning: One who is content and brings happiness and joy to others. The name Reyaz carries the meaning “content, happy, joyful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Reyaz usually hope their child will grow to embody content, happy, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
